payload.title: 10 Mykonos Wedding Venues for a Cycladic Celebration
payload.excerpt: Mykonos wedding venues fall into five parts of the island: the west-coast bays of Agios Ioannis and Ornos, near Mykonos Town; the south-coast beaches at Psarou and Platis Gialos; Elia further east; the north coast at Agios Sostis; and a hilltop above Paradise beach.
key_takeaways: Start on the west coast if guests want to be near Mykonos Town, look south for beach receptions, and look north for privacy and a chapel.
Guest count narrows the list quickly, because published capacity ranges from a chapel for 25 guests at Mykonos Grand to weddings of up to 800 at Saint John.

Several venues have a chapel of their own, but the rules differ, from religious, civil and symbolic weddings at Grecotel Mykonos Lolita to religious weddings at Mykonos Grand only when both partners are Christian Orthodox.
Greek summers bring frequent heatwaves and a wildfire season from June to September, so plan shade, a later ceremony and a covered fallback for a summer date.

faq.q: Which part of Mykonos suits a wedding?
faq.a: It depends on your guest list and the setting you want. The west coast at Agios Ioannis and Ornos keeps guests close to Mykonos Town, with Katikies Mykonos about 4 km away. The south coast at Psarou and Platis Gialos puts the beach at the centre, Elia has the largest published ballroom, and Agios Sostis on the north coast is the secluded choice.

faq.q: Are there wedding chapels at Mykonos venues?
faq.a: Yes. Santa Marina, Mykonos Grand, Saint John, the Myconian Ambassador, the Myconian Collection's Elia hotels and Grecotel Mykonos Lolita all describe a chapel. Mykonos Grand's holds 25 guests inside, and a religious wedding there requires both partners to be Christian Orthodox.

faq.q: Can we book a Mykonos venue for exclusive use?
faq.a: Ask directly, because few venues publish it. Katikies Hotels lists a hotel take-over among its event enquiry types. For the others, exclusive use is not published, so confirm with each venue whether the wedding spaces or the whole property can be reserved for you.

faq.q: Can we have a beach wedding in Mykonos?
faq.a: Several venues hold the ceremony or reception right by the sand. Mykonos Blu's Ocean Balcony sits just above Psarou beach, and the Myconian Collection and Myconian Ambassador both offer receptions on the beach. Ask each venue whether a ceremony on the sand itself is possible on your date.

faq.q: How do guests get to Mykonos?
faq.a: They fly into Mykonos Airport (JMK), about 45 minutes from Athens and 1 hour 10 minutes from Thessaloniki. From the airport, a bus runs to Mykonos Town and a taxi stand sits outside Arrivals.

faq.q: Can Australians legally get married in Mykonos?
faq.a: Plan the legal steps first. As at November 2026, Smartraveller says you may need a Certificate of No Impediment, and a marriage valid in Greece that would also be valid under Australian law is in most cases recognised in Australia.
